_note: Shop stock pools by Heat tier. The tier numbering is placement.heat_tier's, which world.md 8.3's five rows collapse into four: its bands are (0-2)(3-5)(6-8)(9-20), so the table's tier 4 is the same numbers as its tier 3 and only the freeze differs. Tier 3 here is therefore the ceiling pool and equals the full catalogue. Prices are NOT in this file: DECISIONS section 9 owns GEAR_PRICES and section 16 owns TRAUMA_PATCH_COST. The pools are price-banded - tier 0 stocks the six cheapest lines and each tier adds dearer ones - because world.md 3.2 says stock is weighted to the current tier without giving weights.
